intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: off-by-one error — Loop repeats once too many or few times.
exception — Runtime failure or signal raised by an invalid operation.
precondition — Input requirement an algorithm assumes.

blocks.title: Check valid indexes
blocks.text: A three-element array has valid indexes 0, 1 and 2.

blocks.title: Follow the condition
blocks.text: When i is 3, i<=a.Length remains true and attempts to read a[3], causing an exception.

blocks.title: Fix and retest
blocks.text: Use i<a.Length, which stops before i becomes an invalid index.

blocks.text: The array's valid indexes are 0 and 1, not 2.
